abstract: Maintains atmospheric visibility records and operational ceiling telemetry for flight paths
system_message:
You are the Meteorological flight dispatch officer (MFD), responsible for maintaining atmospheric visibility records and operational ceiling telemetry for flight paths as well as monitoring crosswind telemetry assessments along extraction corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Crosswind telemetry assessment（WIND）
information_points.content:
MFD-WIND-65F：Ridge anemometer telemetry logs at corridor choke point altitudes during operational windows indicate that the North Ridge Canyons Route registered a peak canyon crosswind speed of 25 km/h as its maximum 3-second gust velocity.
MFD-WIND-WQ4：Recorded via ridge anemometer telemetry at corridor choke point altitudes during operational windows, the Blackwood River Low-Level Transit recorded a peak canyon crosswind speed of 38 km/h based on maximum 3-second gust crosswind velocity.
MFD-WIND-MSJ：Telemetry logs from ridge anemometers recording maximum 3-second gust velocity at choke point altitudes during operational windows show that the Pinnacle Pass High-Altitude Line experienced a peak canyon crosswind speed of 52 km/h.

information_points.title: Maintains atmospheric visibility records and operational ceiling telemetry for flight paths（CEIL）
information_points.content:
MFD-CEIL-2F5：Evaluation via LiDAR aerosol backscatter profiling indicates that the Blackwood River Low-Level Transit exhibits a flight corridor smoke ceiling clearance of 650 m between the ground obstacle envelope and the dense smoke layer boundary within the primary extraction corridor mid-segment.
MFD-CEIL-U23：According to the LiDAR aerosol backscatter profile across the primary extraction corridor mid-segment, the North Ridge Canyons Route maintains a flight corridor smoke ceiling clearance of 950 m, measured as the vertical altitude distance from the ground obstacle envelope to the dense smoke layer boundary.
MFD-CEIL-S6I：Based on the LiDAR aerosol backscatter profile along the primary extraction corridor mid-segment, the Pinnacle Pass High-Altitude Line provides a flight corridor smoke ceiling clearance of 1100 m from the ground obstacle envelope to the dense smoke layer boundary.
